queries.query: Tarsus Türkiye official cadastral parcel map TKGM Parsel Sorgu Tarsus
queries.result: Found the first-party TKGM Parsel Sorgulama service documentation and the official public viewer; it states that parcel location and basic cadastral attributes can be viewed by province/district/neighborhood and parcel identifiers.

queries.query: Tarsus resmi parsel sorgu kadastro haritası TKGM
queries.result: Found the first-party Turkish TKGM Parsel Sorgu documentation and the official Tarsus Municipality E-İmar viewer. The TKGM documentation identifies Parsel Sorgu as a public map service; the municipality page exposes a parcel-search interface but is not used as the canonical parcel API.

source.provider: Tapu ve Kadastro Genel Müdürlüğü (TKGM), MEGSİS Parsel Sorgu
source.discoveryEvidence: The current viewer HTML loads main.js?v=76.3; its current configuration defines the MEGSİS API host above. The viewer defaults to Turkish and supports English language selection.
source.scope: National first-party cadastre service; responses identify Tarsus district and Mersin province. This is local parcel coverage evidence, not a claim of complete citywide coverage.
source.geometryCrs: GeoJSON coordinates were returned as [longitude, latitude] in decimal degrees; no CRS member was supplied in the response.
source.nativeIdentity: The service exposes a parcel identity as the composite of mahalleId + adaNo + parselNo; no synthetic row number was used. The city packet retains no raw source attribute set and no GeoJSON sample.
